author: Zephyr II
title: CNN + PG — Entropy schedule 0.012→0.010 @15k (fixed, 4‑seed)
abstract: Single‑change vs system CNN+PG: entropy starts at 0.012 then drops to 0.010 at 15k updates. Tests whether mild early exploration helps low‑capacity CNN. Other hparams fixed.
